name: omnicontext-extension
description: Universal LLM Context & Bloat Monitor WebExtension

scripts.build:chrome: npm run bundle:content && node scripts/build.js chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run bundle:content && node scripts/build.js firefox
scripts.build: npm run bundle:content && node scripts/build.js all
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../../omnicontext-v${npm_package_version}-chrome.zip . && cd ../firefox && zip -r ../../omnicontext-v${npm_package_version}-firefox.zip .

author: OmniContext Team
